action: AgWeb says USDA expects most FSA programs to be running by end of business Friday. General advice: use official USDA channels for updates.
date_note: Date is the Nextgov report; the internal disclosure was earlier that week (an email sent Monday).
exec: A US federal agency that pays farmers has taken applications offline after a security incident; who was responsible is not yet known.
plain: The US Department of Agriculture had a security incident and took several systems offline, including tools used to pay farmers. An official says no data was lost; who did it is not yet known.

sources.name: ABC Color (EFE, relaying NBC News), 20 Nov 2026
El Tiempo de Monclova (agencies, relaying NBC News), 20 Nov 2026

summary: Nextgov reports, citing anonymous sources and internal notices, that USDA applications were taken offline after a security incident; Hackread names Farm Service Agency loan software and the NRCS ProTracts payment system among them. Under Secretary Richard Fordyce acknowledged "limited outages" (AgWeb), confirmed a cyber threat and said no data was lost and no personally identifiable information was involved (Hackread). EFE, relaying NBC News, says attackers reached a farmer-payment platform. Responsibility is unresolved.
title: USDA takes multiple systems offline after internal security incident

validation.note: Verify desk read Nextgov/FCW (19 Nov; on-record 16 Nov email from USDA FPAC Business Center acting assistant CIO Chris Rottler: security incident, passwords reset, outages) and NBC News (20 Nov; unnamed sources: farmer-payment system accessed by hackers, no other systems targeted as of Friday). Independent reporting of a security incident with outages. NBC wording (cyberattack, breach by outside actor) rests on anonymous sources; USDA publicly says only security incident, no usda.gov statement found, no attribution. Follow-up 2026-11-22T18:20:02Z: Hackread (22 Nov, read in full) lists FSA loan software, NRCS ProTracts payment and mapping software and VPN problems; quotes Fordyce: no PII, no data lost, most systems expected back by Friday evening; perpetrator unknown. Engadget (21 Nov) says it is unclear whether the USDA and FBI incidents are related. No restoration confirmation found; The Guardian could not be fetched.

review.note: Compared with Nextgov, AgWeb, Hackread: Fordyce quotes, systems named, status developing match. Fixed: action advice (unsourced 'intermittent outages' removed; General advice labelled)
